spec_family.name: New Construction Wood Grain Fill (Paint Grade)
spec_family.description: Standalone grain fill add-on spec for open-grain hardwoods being painted. User-activated toggle on any bare_wood substrate with paint coating type. Fills open grain pores with water-based grain filler (AquaCoat or similar) before finish painting. Quality tier controls fill coat count: QT3=1 coat, QT4=2 coats, QT5=3 coats. Includes interstage sanding between fill coats and a second prime coat (seal coat) over filled surface. Chains between parent prime spec and parent finish spec: Parent Prime → Grain Fill → Parent Finish. This is the first add-on spec in the system — it does not replace or modify the parent spec, it inserts additional process steps between prime and finish phases. No protection zones (runs within parent spec's already-protected workspace). Single SF-based paintable item (ITM_GRAIN_FILL_SURFACE) representing the sum of all grain-fill-enabled substrates' SF after UOM conversion. Surface_profile is the dominant production modifier (flat=1.0x to heavy_profile=2.8x). Wood_species modifier (deep_grain/moderate_grain) affects fill and sand tasks only.

includes: Sand prep of primed surface before grain fill (220 grit)
Grain filler skim coat application (1/2/3 coats by quality tier)
Sanding between fill coats (220-320 grit progression)
Final sand at QT5 only (400 grit for glass-smooth surface)
Second prime coat (seal coat over filled surface — uses parent spec's primer)
Sand second prime (320 grit for finish coat adhesion)
All work on open-grain hardwoods: red oak, white oak, ash, walnut, mahogany, hickory, elm, chestnut

excludes.item: Initial prime coat — handled by parent prime spec
excludes.route_to: SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME, SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_PRIME, or other parent prime spec

excludes.item: Finish paint coats — handled by parent finish spec
excludes.route_to: SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT, SF_WOOD_WALL_NC, SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT, or other parent finish spec

excludes.item: Stain-grade grain fill (different process — fill then stain, not fill then paint)
Auto-detection of wood species — user decides when grain fill is needed
Protection setup/teardown — parent spec handles workspace protection
Closed-grain wood species (maple, cherry, poplar, birch, pine, alder, MDF)
excludes.route_to: N/A — these species do not need grain fill

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling fill coat count, sanding progression, and final sand. QT3=1 fill coat. QT4=2 fill coats. QT5=3 fill coats + final 400 grit sand.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2 not applicable — grain fill is premium prep work for painted millwork. QT follows project/room tier setting. More coats = more grain pore fill = smoother surface.

configuration_dimensions.description: Surface profile complexity. Dominant production modifier — profiled surfaces require hand work.
configuration_dimensions.notes: flat=cabinet doors, flat trim, flat panels. light_profile=simple casing, baseboard with small profile. medium_profile=crown molding, chair rail, standard raised panel. heavy_profile=ornate crown, complex raised panel, dentil trim.

paintable_items.name: Grain fill surface area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Sum of all grain-fill-enabled substrates' SF after UOM conversion. LF substrates (trim, baseboard, casing) convert 1:1 to SF. EA doors convert via type-based SF lookup (slab=~21 SF/side × sides). SF substrates (walls, wainscot, cabinets) pass through directly. Sourced from PaintScope input PS_SURFACE_SF.GRAIN_FILL.
paintable_items.notes: Single SF item representing all grain-fill-enabled surfaces. Aggregated from multiple parent substrates. UOM conversion happens in quantity-lookups.js before emitting PS key.

variants.notes: Standard grain fill. 1 fill coat + 1 sand between + seal prime + sand prime. Sufficient for satin finish on standard millwork.
Premium grain fill. 2 fill coats + 2 sands between + seal prime + sand prime. Smoother surface for semi-gloss finish.
Superior grain fill. 3 fill coats + 3 sands between + final 400 grit sand + seal prime + sand prime. Glass-smooth surface for gloss finish.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Total SF of all grain-fill-enabled substrates after UOM conversion. Emitted by quantity-lookups.js when any substrate has grain_fill=true.
Height classification for modifier selection. Standard height modifiers applied to all tasks.

adjacency_declarations.notes: No adjacency declarations — grain fill is an add-on process that operates on the same surface as the parent spec. It does not interact with adjacent surfaces.

valid_input_states.notes: Surface must already be primed by parent spec. Grain filler adheres to primed surface, not bare wood.

output_state.notes: New state. Surface is grain-filled, sealed with second prime, and sanded 320 grit. Ready for finish paint. Parent finish spec must accept SS_GRAIN_FILLED as valid input state.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Grain fill inserts between parent prime and parent finish specs. Chain: Parent Prime → Grain Fill → Parent Finish. The grain fill process is a prep add-on that happens after initial primer but before finish coats.
sequencing_notes.internal_sequence: Sand prep > Fill coat(s) with interstage sand > [QT5: Final sand] > Seal prime > Sand prime. Single paintable item — no component sequencing.
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Sand prep (220) > Fill coat 1 > Sand (220) > [QT4+: Fill coat 2 > Sand (280-320)] > [QT5: Fill coat 3 > Sand (320) > Final sand (400)] > Seal prime > Sand prime (320)

relationships.notes: First add-on spec in the system. Activates via user toggle on any bare_wood paint substrate. Chains between prime and finish phases of parent spec.

sections_used: Modifier Application Rule (time multipliers, not rate multipliers)

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Dry times should be specified in specs
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: No dry times in specs — refer to product PDS.

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Material system selection is mandatory doctrine
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: Material systems are suggestions per QT — contractor has discretion.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for NC wood grain fill (Spec #19 in generation order). Key features: standalone add-on spec (first in system), user-activated toggle, quality tier drives fill coat count (QT3=1, QT4=2, QT5=3), surface_profile dominant modifier (1.0-2.8x), wood_species modifier (deep/moderate grain), single SF paintable item (ITM_GRAIN_FILL_SURFACE) with UOM conversion from parent substrates, no protection zones (parent spec workspace), state chain SS_PRIMED_* → SS_GRAIN_FILLED, 6 tasks across 5 modules, 3 round configurations, 3 variants. New proposed: PS_SURFACE_SF.GRAIN_FILL (aggregation key), SS_GRAIN_FILLED (new state), ITM_GRAIN_FILL_SURFACE (new item), SYS_GRAIN_FILLER_WB (new material system).
